subGoals.rule: The licence status has one owner (licensing); the market reaches it only through the owner's published interface and never re-decides it from the vendor's record (Fowler P3; Evans bounded context). Which status a kind of pitch admits is a market rule.
Reporting a no-show changes no vendor: the strike follows from the stored NoShowReported fact delivered to the owning context (Vernon P4, eventual consistency outside the boundary).

plantedDebt.what: imports licensing's VendorRepository and VendorId from its domain (cross-context internal import) to print trading names

precedent: both: a clean published interface (licensing index.ts LicensingDesk, LicenceSheet contract, market acl LicensingGateway) and a stored-fact reaction by the owner (licensing's vendorTraded subscribed to the stored VendorCheckedIn in the composition root, which keeps the licence's last trading date); and a trap-shaped one (PitchPlan reads vendors through licensing's domain repository).
